nodes.label: Operations & Maintenance Team (O&MT)
nodes.description: Community committee trained during Stage 3 to manage, operate, and maintain completed sub-project infrastructure and livelihood assets.

nodes.label: SM7: Monitoring & Evaluation Sub-Manual
nodes.description: DSWD Sub-Manual 7 detailing the M&E framework, Theory of Change, Results Matrix, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Community Monitoring Toolkit, and Data Quality Assessment protocols.

nodes.label: Community Monitoring Sub-Committee (CMSC)
nodes.description: Formed at 2nd Barangay Assembly (BA2). Composed of at least three (3) Community Volunteers selected specifically from among BResT ranks. Has its own elected Chairperson to oversee sub-project monitoring, ESMP safeguards, and BAR reporting (SM7, p. 15 & pp. 108-109).

nodes.label: Community Monitoring Toolkit (Annex L)
nodes.description: Participatory toolkit providing CMSC with Community Monitoring Plan templates, Work Plan guides, Data Gathering checklists, and BAR reporting guidelines.

nodes.label: 2nd Barangay Assembly (BA2): PRVA Validation & Committee Formation
nodes.description: Presentation of BPRVA and MRP results, selection of CRSPMC officers (Chair, Vice-Chair, Sec, Treas) and election of 3 CMSC monitors from among BResT ranks.
nodes.norm_label: 2nd barangay assembly (ba2): prva validation & committee formation

nodes.label: 4th Barangay Assembly / Barangay Accountability Reporting (BAR)
nodes.description: Public accountability meeting presenting physical completion, financial liquidation, CMSC monitoring findings, audit report, and asset turnover to O&MT.

nodes.label: PCRP M&E Results Framework & Theory of Change
nodes.description: SM7 logical framework linking inputs and activities (social mobilization, CapBuild, civil works) to intermediate outputs and ultimate resilience outcomes.
nodes.norm_label: pcrp m&e results framework & theory of change

nodes.label: CRIP Stage 4: Community-Based Monitoring & Review
nodes.description: Stage 4 activities: Community Monitoring Sub-Committee (CMSC) inspections, Barangay Accountability Reporting (BAR / BA4), physical completion inspection, and O&M turnover.

nodes.label: Barangay Development Council (BDC) Endorsement
nodes.description: BLGU session adopting the BPRVA resilience plan and incorporating PCRP priorities into the Annual Investment Plan (AIP) and Barangay Development Plan (BDP).

nodes.label: KALAHI-CIDSS Comprehensive Information System (KCIS)
nodes.description: Central digital repository tracking participant attendance, volunteer registries, sub-project milestones, and liquidation reports across municipalities.

nodes.label: Area Coordinating Team (ACT)
nodes.description: DSWD field deployment team: Area Coordinator (AC), Community Facilitators (CF), Technical Facilitator Engineers (TFA), and Monitoring & Evaluation Assistants (MEA).

nodes.label: Municipal Resilience Team (MResT)
nodes.description: Inter-departmental municipal committee created via Executive Order, chaired by the Municipal Mayor or MPDO/MDRRMO, comprising MPDO, MEEDO, MENRO, MSWDO, MAO, MEO, and CSO representatives.

nodes.label: Municipal Coordinating Team (MCT)
nodes.description: LGU counterpart staff designated to partner with ACT, facilitate PRVA, and co-monitor community resilience operations.

nodes.label: Municipal Resilience Planning (MRP) Workshop
nodes.description: Municipal workshop led by MResT integrating barangay concept notes into the municipal resilience investment pipeline and aligning with CDRA/CLUP.

nodes.label: Data Quality Assessment (DQA) & Verification Protocols
nodes.description: Systematic protocols cross-referencing physical hardcopy evidence (attendance sheets, minutes, resolutions, photos, executive orders) against digital records in KCIS.

nodes.label: Barangay Resilience Team (BResT)
nodes.description: Community volunteers formed at the 1st Barangay Assembly (BA1) representing all puroks/sitios, major economic sectors, and at least 30% marginalized groups. MANDATE: Conduct PRVA walk-through mapping, mobilize FGDs, and attend BPRVA workshops. GOVERNANCE RULE: NO CHAIRPERSON IS REQUIRED OR APPOINTED (SM1, Part 3, pp. 16-18; SM7, p. 15).

nodes.label: BResT Composition Rule: No Chairperson Needed
nodes.description: Explicit structural policy under PCRP SM1 & SM7: The BResT is a collective broad-based assembly of community volunteers representing geographic zones and sectors. Unlike executive committees (CSPMC, CMSC, SFMSC), BResT does NOT require or designate a chairperson. Validation systems must not penalize teams lacking a chairperson.
nodes.norm_label: brest composition rule: no chairperson needed

nodes.label: Risk & Vulnerability Walk-Through and Spot Mapping
nodes.description: Hands-on transect walk across all sitios/puroks conducted by BResT volunteers and Community Facilitators to identify hazard-prone areas and lifeline infrastructure.
nodes.norm_label: risk & vulnerability walk-through and spot mapping

nodes.label: Participatory Risk & Vulnerability Assessment (PRVA)
nodes.description: Multi-step community diagnosis: risk mapping, walk-through observations, demographic profiling, economic/marginalized FGDs, and vulnerability matrix generation.

nodes.label: Barangay PRVA Workshop
nodes.description: Participatory analysis workshop where BResT synthesizes mapping and FGD data to prioritize climate-resilience sub-project concepts.

nodes.label: BResT 30% Marginalized Quota Rule
nodes.description: SM1 Part 3, paragraph 22: At least 30% of BResT Community Volunteers must represent marginalized sectors (women, IP, PWD, elderly, youth), with full geographic representation of all puroks/sitios and economic sectors (farmers/fishers).

nodes.label: Focused Group Discussions (FGDs) with Sectors
nodes.description: Targeted consultations facilitated by CFs with economic groups (farmers, fishers), indigenous peoples (IPs), and women to assess differential risk burdens.

nodes.label: Project Implementation Team (PIT)
nodes.description: CRSPMC technical sub-committee responsible for physical construction, day-to-day site supervision, and work scheduling.

nodes.label: Community Resilience Sub-Project Management Committee (CRSPMC / CSPMC)
nodes.description: Elected at 2nd Barangay Assembly (BA2) to lead community sub-project implementation. Has designated Chairperson, Vice-Chair, Secretary, and Treasurer.
nodes.norm_label: community resilience sub-project management committee (crspmc / cspmc)

nodes.label: Audit & Inventory Team (AIT)
nodes.description: Independent committee checking materials received, inventory storage, and auditing financial vouchers before liquidation.

nodes.label: CRIP Stage 3: Community-Managed Sub-Project Implementation
nodes.description: Stage 3 activities: Sub-project execution, community procurement, community labor engagement, ESMP safeguards enforcement, and progress liquidation.

nodes.label: Community Procurement Team (PT)
nodes.description: Sub-committee managing community shopping, canvassing, bidding, and supplier contracting following World Bank and DSWD procurement guidelines.

nodes.label: Sub-Project Development Workshop (SPDW)
nodes.description: Technical planning sessions with CRSPMC, TFA engineers, and municipal engineers to finalize Program of Works (POW), DED, and procurement packaging.

nodes.label: Environmental and Social Management Plan (ESMP)
nodes.description: World Bank Environmental and Social Framework compliance instrument ensuring ecological protection, disaster risk mitigation, and indigenous rights.

nodes.label: SM1: Social Mobilization Sub-Manual
nodes.description: DSWD Sub-Manual 1 detailing the Community Resilience Implementation Process (CRIP), stages 1 to 4, participatory risk assessments, BResT selection, and sub-project development.

nodes.label: Technical Desk Review (TDR) & RPMO Appraisal
nodes.description: Multi-disciplinary review by Regional Project Management Office (RPMO) evaluating engineering soundness, cost-efficiency, and ESMP safeguards compliance.

nodes.label: 3rd Barangay Assembly (BA3): Sub-Project Proposal Approval
nodes.description: Review and community voting/approval of the final sub-project technical design, budget, procurement plan, and LGU local counterpart contribution.

nodes.label: CRIP Stage 1: Participatory Assessment & Resilience Planning
nodes.description: Stage 1 activities: MResT meeting, 1st Barangay Assembly (BA1), PRVA profiling/walk-through/mapping, FGDs, BPRVA workshop, MRP workshop, and BDC plan endorsement.
nodes.norm_label: crip stage 1: participatory assessment & resilience planning

nodes.label: CRIP Stage 2: Community Resilience Sub-Project Development
nodes.description: Stage 2 activities: 2nd Barangay Assembly (BA2), CRSPMC & CMSC formation, Sub-Project Development Workshop (SPDW), 3rd Barangay Assembly (BA3), Technical Desk Review (TDR), and fund allocation.
nodes.norm_label: crip stage 2: community resilience sub-project development

nodes.label: Community Resilience Implementation Process (CRIP)
nodes.description: The four-stage community-driven development operational cycle of PCRP: 1. Assessment & Planning, 2. Sub-Project Development, 3. Implementation, 4. Monitoring & Review.

nodes.label: 1st Barangay Assembly (BA1): Project Orientation & Team Selection
nodes.description: Community orientation on PCRP, presentation of preliminary hazard data, selection of BResT volunteers (no chairperson) and SFMSC members, and scheduling of PRVA walk-throughs and FGDs.
nodes.norm_label: 1st barangay assembly (ba1): project orientation & team selection

nodes.label: Stakeholder & Feedback Mechanism Sub-Committee (SFMSC)
nodes.description: Grievance and accountability committee selected during 1st Barangay Assembly (BA1) to manage the Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM), logs community queries, and ensure transparency. Has an elected Chairperson.

nodes.label: Household Quorum Standard (K2 Standard)
nodes.description: Mandatory attendance benchmark requiring presence of household representatives at assemblies: minimum 50% (regular) or 80% (high-density/special criteria) of rostered households.
